newsitem.title: UK: Antisoma Plc to seek full market listing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Antisoma Plc to seek full market listing in 1997.

text.p: Antisoma Plc said on Friday it had raised 8.5 million stg in a placing and planned to seek a full London Stock Exchange listing in 1997.
The biopharmaceutical company uses tumour targeting compounds to diagnose and treat cancer.

"We are particularly pleased to have succeeded in raising the full amount of new capital that we had targeted in what appears to be a difficult climate for fund-raising for companies in our sector," said chief executive officer Ian McBeath.
Theragyn, Antisoma's most advanced product, is for the treatment of ovarian cancer and is in Phase III clinical trials.
The proceeds of the 8.5 million stg placing, which valued the company at 40.0 million stg, will be used to extend the trials in Europe and the United States.
The adviser to the placing was Apax Partners & Co.
